modalities.evidence: two sessions of testing: MRI scanning and behavioral tests
The second session consisted of only behavioral tests
followed by a survey: Reading Background Questionnaire (RBQ)

output.population: Native English speaker (L1) adults; 52 participants tested in two sessions collected 2-3 days apart
output.summary: Native English speaker adult subset of the Reading Brain Project: structural and resting-state imaging, a reading task with simultaneous eye-tracking and fMRI, a diffusion scan, plus a second session of standardized behavioral tests and a questionnaire.
